scope: Five saved AftExhaust R1 artifacts: 34-part named-state inventories, isolated body/liner identity, independent Boolean loft provenance, rounded rear/liner openings, connector void continuity, retained tail pockets/supports, stowed envelope, and 66 sampled liner-to-peer checks. No source rebuild, render, continuous sweep, airflow, or visual approval.

thresholds.saved_component_topology: one valid positive-volume solid per saved leaf

isolated_body_matches_full_Stowed.comparison: isolated Body_Duct against full Stowed body

independent_liner_profiles_isolation_and.probe_method: Positive-volume loft probes use matched rounded profiles, not square cornered boxes.

connector_void_continuity_and_material_c.interpretation: Connected geometric void only; no airflow or propulsion claim.

all_other_preexisting_positive_body_cont.basis: All positive-volume contacts are discovered from saved IntakeR3 Stowed; no pair is exempted.

global_stowed_125mm_radius_and_X_envelop.radius_method: Conservative AABB Y/Z corner bound; not a tight radial maximum.

saved_liner_vs_all_32_IntakeR3_peers_at_.measurement_policy: Per-pair AABB distance is a conservative lower bound; when it exceeds 0.2 mm no exact distance is queried. Exact nearest distance is queried only when that bound cannot prove the strict threshold. The reported minimum is a proven lower bound, not an exact global minimum.
saved_liner_vs_all_32_IntakeR3_peers_at_.existing_body_clearance_inheritance: The only R3 body edit is independently verified as material removal inside the aft seat/connector cutters; all 32 saved nonbody peers are Boolean-identical to IntakeR3 and their saved poses are independently reconstructed. Removing body material cannot reduce prior body clearance. This check covers all 32 peers against the saved liner at the stated samples.
saved_liner_vs_all_32_IntakeR3_peers_at_.continuous_motion_claim: None; these are the specified 66 discrete synchronous samples.
